tracks.name: Web development
tracks.description: Build a strong JavaScript foundation, then move into React.

tracks.name: Python foundations
tracks.description: Work confidently with values, collections, and functions.

tracks.name: SQL & databases
tracks.description: Read, combine, and summarise relational data.

topics.name: JavaScript values
topics.summary: JavaScript has primitive values and objects. const prevents reassignment of a binding; it does not freeze an object. Strict equality does not coerce different types.

topics.name: Functions & scope
topics.summary: Functions accept arguments and can return values. A closure retains access to its lexical environment. An omitted return produces undefined.

topics.name: Arrays & transformations
topics.summary: map creates an array from callback results. filter keeps elements whose predicate is truthy. Neither method directly mutates the source array, though callbacks can mutate referenced objects.

topics.name: Promises & async
topics.summary: A promise represents eventual completion or failure. An async function returns a promise. await suspends the surrounding async function until a promise settles; it does not block the whole JavaScript thread.

topics.name: React state
topics.summary: State stores information between renders. A state setter schedules a render. Treat arrays and objects in state as immutable; derive new values instead of changing existing state directly.

topics.name: Python values
topics.summary: Python has numeric, string, and collection types. The / operator performs true division; // performs floor division. Strings are immutable.

topics.name: Python collections
topics.summary: Lists are mutable sequences. Tuples are immutable sequences. Dictionaries map hashable keys to values. Sets contain distinct elements.

topics.name: Python functions
topics.summary: def introduces a function. return sends a value back to the caller; falling off the end returns None. Mutable default arguments are evaluated once at definition time.

topics.name: Queries & filtering
topics.summary: SELECT reads rows. WHERE filters rows before grouping. ORDER BY sorts the result. Test for null values with IS NULL rather than equality to NULL.

topics.name: Joining tables
topics.summary: INNER JOIN keeps matching pairs. LEFT JOIN preserves each left-side row, using nulls for right-side columns when there is no match. Multiple matches can produce multiple output rows.

topics.name: Grouping & aggregates
topics.summary: GROUP BY forms groups for aggregates. HAVING filters groups after aggregation. COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(column) counts non-null values of that column.
